questions.q: What is the first step to achieving success according to the book?
a: Define your values and work for yourself
questions.why: The book stresses defining values and self‑employment.

questions.q: Why does the author warn against toxic friends?
questions.why: Toxic friends are said to spoil progress.

questions.q: Which historical figure is used to illustrate learning from failure?
questions.why: Steve Jobs' firing and comeback are highlighted.

questions.q: What does the book say about standing out?
a: It is acceptable if you have a unique vision
questions.why: Standing out with a different vision is encouraged.

questions.q: What is the main lesson from the letter David receives?
questions.why: The letter introduces the nine mistakes to avoid.
